desc:
🧲 Throw your magnet into the canal... CLACK! Something HEAVY just grabbed on. Reel it up and see what you found!

🚗 97 things to find: bikes, safes, sports cars, a Golden Dragon, a Galaxy Egg... and the legendary Giant Tin Robot!
🌈 Lucky catches come out SHINY, DIAMOND or super rare RAINBOW, worth up to x15!
🌊 10 zones: from the bridge down to THE CORE... and beyond with REBIRTH
💰 Sell at the dumpster, land a TRICK SHOT or CHARGE IT for up to x3 cash
🏡 Your best finds make money on YOUR PLOT every second, even offline
🎁 Free gifts every day  ·  💣 Magnet Bomb  ·  📖 Index and Hall of Fame

👥 +10% cash for each friend in your server (up to +30%)!
👍 Like and ⭐ favorite so you don't miss the next update!
